title: Brussel Sprouts Pasta
ingredients: fish and oyster sauce to taste (optional)
instructions: Tenderize the veggies by steaming so they are soft
Chop up chicken breast and season with salt, pepper, smoked paprika, garlic and baking powder. Coat in flour and fry until golden and cripsy. Set aside.
In the same pan fry the veggies until golden on the outside, add some soy sauce and fish sauce.
Make a mixture of ketchup, water, dark soy sauce, sugar, and sriracha, mix it into the veggies.
Mix some flour with water, and add into the pan.
Add meat back in and cook for a bit.
Serve with a garnish of sesame seeds and spring onion, with some noodles.
